scoring_justification: T1: The headline quantities (shift at key powers, trend linear/quadratic, cutoff frequency) can be recomputed from the agent's raw artifacts. The checker compares shift/temp values at specified powers to paper-derived references and examines the trend in the CSV data.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold shift and temperature values at 4.2 and 12.7 mW for standard and re-etched toroids, and cutoff frequency.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper-reported: silica temperature 443 K at 12.7 mW (re-etched), tuning sensitivity 3200 fm/mW (standard), thermo-optic relation Eq (1) with λ0=1.566 μm, n0=1.444, dn/dT(T)=2.6e-8 T + 7.5e-7 K^{-1}, T0=300 K, temperature-to-shift slope 9.2 pm/K (standard). Cutoff frequency ~5000 Hz. Derived shifts consistent with paper figures.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Standard toroid: shift=power*3.2 pm/mW (3200 fm/mW), temperature from shift / 9.2 pm/K + 300 K. Re-etched: at 12.7 mW T=443 K, shift = (λ0/n0)*dn/dT(443)*(143) = 1902 pm; at 4.2 mW T estimated 350 K, shift computed similarly = 534 pm. Cutoff 5000 Hz.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: All values are either directly in the paper or derived directly from its equations and reported parameters without arbitrary choice.

outputs.description: Predicted resonance wavelength shift as a function of pump power for both standard and re-etched toroids, derived from steady-state finite-element heat-flow simulations and the thermo-optic coefficient relation.

schema.description: Single floating-point number, the thermal equilibration cutoff frequency in Hz.

outputs.description: Predicted thermal equilibration cutoff frequency for a standard toroid geometry from time-dependent finite-element simulations.

output_contract.notes: The checker compares the agent's shift values at key pump powers and the cutoff frequency to the paper-reported values with appropriate tolerances, and may also verify the shift-vs-power trend (linear for standard toroid, quadratic for re-etched toroid).
